candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The output variable nu_t/nu is the normalized eddy viscosity, which is dimensionless as it is a ratio of eddy viscosity to kinematic viscosity. The inputs are the wall-friction velocity u_tau (velocity scale), the channel half-height h (length scale), the distance from the wall y (length scale), and the fluid kinematic viscosity nu (kinematic viscosity). These quantities are sufficient to form dimensionless groups governing the normalized eddy viscosity in turbulent channel flow.

final_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The output variable nu_t/nu is the normalized eddy viscosity, which is dimensionless as it is a ratio of eddy viscosity to kinematic viscosity. The inputs are the wall-friction velocity u_tau (velocity scale), the channel half-height h (length scale), the distance from the wall y (length scale), and the fluid kinematic viscosity nu (kinematic viscosity). These quantities are sufficient to form dimensionless groups governing the normalized eddy viscosity in turbulent channel flow.
